error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Midnight Alerts

data.enable_crash_reporting: Send crash reports to Midnight Security

data_description.enable_crash_reporting: Helps us catch bugs faster. Only the error type and message are sent - never your address, API key, or alert data.

data_description.exit_time: How long to count down after arming before the area is fully armed
data_description.entry_time: How long to count down after a sensor trips before the alarm actually triggers
data_description.trigger_time: How long the alarm stays triggered before automatically resetting

data.arm_on_close: New sensors: hold arming open until closed

data_description.arm_on_close: If a newly-attached sensor is still open when the exit delay ends, wait for it to close instead of arming with it open
data_description.delay_on: A newly-attached sensor must stay open this many seconds before it's treated as a real trip - filters a momentary blip. 0 disables debouncing
data_description.always_on: This sensor triggers the alarm regardless of arm state, even while disarmed
data_description.entry_delay: Overrides the area mode's own entry delay for just this sensor. Leave blank to use the area's default
data_description.modes: Restrict this sensor to only trigger while armed in these modes. Leave blank for no restriction

data_description.entities: Each of these must also be individually attached to the relevant area via that area's "Manage sensors" step
data_description.timeout: How many seconds apart member trips can be and still count together
data_description.event_count: How many members must trip within the window before it counts as one confirmed event

user.title: Import from Alarmo
user.description: Found {areas} area(s), {users} user(s), {sensor_groups} sensor group(s), and {sensors} sensor(s) to import. PINs carry over and keep working immediately. {automations_skipped} Alarmo automation(s) will NOT be imported - recreate the ones you still need as ordinary Home Assistant automations.

abort.alarmo_not_found: No Alarmo storage file was found - Alarmo doesn't appear to be installed on this Home Assistant instance
abort.alarmo_version_mismatch: Alarmo's storage is a version this importer doesn't understand - open Alarmo once to let it finish migrating, then try again
abort.already_imported: This Alarmo configuration has already been imported - nothing to do
abort.import_complete: Imported {areas} area(s), {users} user(s), {sensor_groups} sensor group(s), and {sensors} sensor(s) ({sensors_skipped} sensor(s) skipped - not found in this Home Assistant instance). {automations_skipped} automation(s) were not imported.

data_description.area_limit: Restrict this code to specific areas. Leave blank for no restriction
